title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-28
ranking_basis: GitHub Trending daily stars gained, ordered by the supplied attention score; snapshot deltas unavailable.
ranking_explanation: The supplied daily signal file is the primary ranking source. Selected candidates are ordered by its score (period_gain plus a 0.5-weighted days_trending_30d component); daily Trending stars_gained are shown explicitly and are not confused with total stars. All selected candidates have 8 tracked trending days in the 30-day window.
global_caveat: The signal collector could not retrieve historical star snapshots because GitHub CLI authentication was unavailable. Therefore delta_1d, delta_7d, and delta_30d are null, not zero. Search API was rate-limited for mjmirza/app-store-compliance; direct GitHub repository and commit endpoints were used to verify it. Attention scores are signals, not a measure of intrinsic importance.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent-oriented software workflows and practical agent extensions dominate this snapshot: Claude-BugHunter leads the supplied signals with +1,608 trending stars, while Superpowers, Firecrawl, and several agent skills/tools also show strong momentum. Alongside those, desktop media utilities and agent-created visual artifacts broaden the day's activity beyond coding infrastructure.

sections.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
sections.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for authorized bug hunting and external red-team work, organized around vulnerability research, testing workflow, and reporting.
sections.source_description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
sections.why_notable: It leads the supplied candidates on both daily gain and attention score, with repeated appearances in the tracked month.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: A cross-agent software-development methodology that moves from clarifying a spec to design approval, implementation planning, test-driven development, and subagent execution.
sections.source_description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
sections.why_notable: Its high daily gain and large existing audience reinforce the appetite for structured, reusable coding-agent workflows.

sections.title: firecrawl/firecrawl

sections.why_notable: It applies agent workflows to a concrete visual-design task and ranks among the day's strongest gainers.

sections.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip

sections.source_description: AutoClip｜The open-source OpusClip alternative — local-first AI clipping & MCP server, zero subscriptions. 一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。

sections.unique_caveat: GitHub Search API was rate-limited for this repository; direct repository and commit endpoints confirmed it.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- **Agent workflows and skills:** Claude-BugHunter, Superpowers, last30days-skill, CLI-Anything, and app-store-compliance turn specialized procedures or software operations into reusable agent-facing workflows.
- **Agent-ready knowledge and tools:** Firecrawl supplies web crawling/search pathways, while last30days-skill combines external sources into research summaries; both focus on giving agents usable context.
- **Applied desktop and consumer utilities:** Ghost-Downloader-3 and AutoClip show strong interest in end-user tools alongside developer infrastructure.
- **Agent-created visual and media output:** Diagram Design turns structured visual design into an agent task; AutoClip applies AI to long-to-short video workflows.
- **Small-model learning:** MiniMind is the educational, from-scratch model-training counterpoint in the selected set.
- **Mobile release operations:** App Store Compliance focuses agent-assisted guidance on app review, privacy, and policy deadlines.
- **Languages:** Python is the primary language for 6 of these 10 repositories; Shell for 2, TypeScript for 1, and HTML for 1. This is a directional count of the selected list, not all GitHub activity.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The strongest signal is not just “more AI repos,” but the conversion of workflows, research, software interfaces, and creative tasks into agent-operable tools. The selected list still includes practical standalone utilities and model-learning projects, suggesting that today's momentum spans both agent infrastructure and user-facing applications. Snapshot deltas are unavailable, so repeated-trending days are a persistence hint, not a substitute for historical star-growth comparisons.
